name: qjs_define_property_value_str
prototype: int qjs_define_property_value_str(void *ctx, uint64_t object, const char *name, uint64_t value, int flags)

ownership.argument: Consumes value on both success and failure; object/name borrowed. Interns name into atom, calls generic property definition, releases temporary atom and consumes value reference. Negative return means failure.

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.036 AP producer/consumer and data-layout review; see p67-036-native-contract.md.

notes: Corrects false qjs_define_property_value_str_composition finding. This direct wrapper is ABI-identical to the shared firmware shim. Integer-key delete variant0xC2A46F8 and delete helper0xC2A4680 are unrelated and must not be used.
